GMBC Saturday (VP) Training Ride

South Burlington, VT · Road

GMBC Saturday (VP) Training Ride is a road group ride in South Burlington, VT. Schedule: Saturdays, April to fall. Start time and place are announced on the GMBC email list, usually by Thursday, and change through the year, from Announced on the GMBC email list.

For visitors

GMBC says membership is not required. Sign the club waiver once a season and register for the ride.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the GMBC Saturday (VP) Training Ride group ride

The club's Saturday training ride. GMBC posts the start, route and weather call to its email list by Thursday and asks riders to register. Lights are recommended all season and routes are on Ride with GPS.
